models_evaluated: commercial AI triage system for ICH detection (unnamed)

links.outcome: Radiologist diagnostic performance for ICH detection without vs with AI assistance
links.effect: No significant difference in accuracy (99.5% vs 99.2%), sensitivity (98.6% vs 98.9%), PPV (99.0% vs 97.5%), NPV (99.7% vs 99.7%); specificity lower with AI (99.8% vs 99.3%, p=.004), despite promising retrospective standalone results.
links.quote: This large prospective real-world study does not support use of AI assistance for ICH detection.

links.outcome: Report turnaround time for ICH-positive exams with AI triage notification
links.effect: Mean report turnaround time 147.1 minutes without AI vs 149.9 minutes with AI (p = .11); no improvement.
links.quote: An AI triage system for ICH detection did not improve radiologists' diagnostic performance or report turnaround times.

models_evaluated: commercial AI triage system for ICH detection

links.outcome: diagnostic performance with and without AI
links.effect: Radiologists' accuracy was 99.5% without AI and 99.2% with AI, with significantly lower specificity with AI.
links.quote: Radiologists without versus with AI showed no significant difference in accuracy (99.5% vs 99.2%), sensitivity (98.6% vs 98.9%), PPV (99.0% vs 97.5%), or NPV (99.7% vs 99.7%) (all p > .01); specificity was higher for radiologists without than with AI (99.8% vs 99.3%, respectively, p = .004).

links.effect: Mean turnaround time was 147.1 minutes without AI compared to 149.9 minutes with AI.
links.quote: Mean report turnaround time for ICH-positive examinations was 147.1 minutes without AI versus 149.9 minutes with AI (p = .11).
